violations.text: The establishment is lacking an allergen statement notifying consumers that they must inform staff if they or anyone in their party has a food allergy. Establishment is to post an allergen statement at point of sale or on pastry display case for consumers. New Violation. Correct By: 09/02/2026

The hand-washing sink in the back food preparation area was blocked by equipment and utensils in the sink basin. A hand-washing sink shall be accessible at all times for employee use. Equipment and utensils were moved during the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 08/26/2026

Raspberry donut filling was observed held past the date of disposition. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and shall not be held for more than 7 days including the date of preparation. Food item was voluntarily disposed of during the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/26/2026

Brioche rolls packaged in the food establishment are lacking labels. Food packaged in a food establishment must be labeled with the common name of the food, a list of ingredients, the quantity of the contents, and the business name/address. Labeling guidance provided during the time of inspection. Food items were moved behind the counter and will be sold per consumer request. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/26/2026

A disposable bag fly trap was observed being used to control pest presence. Per use instructions, the product is not to be used within in-door spaces. Establishment is to work with pest control to create an action plan to address pest activity within the establishment using approved commercial pest control products. Product was removed during the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/26/2026

Utensils were observed stored in stagnant water between uses. Utensils between uses shall be maintained in one of the following manners: in water that is maintained at 135 degrees Fahrenheit or more, in water with sufficient flow to flush particulates to the drain, or on a dry clean surface. Utensils were cleaned and sanitized during the time of inspection and moved to dry clean surface during the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/26/2026
Refrigerator door gaskets were observed in poor repair on the walk-in cooler. Refrigerator door gaskets shall be maintained in good repair. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 07/16/2026

Refrigerator door gaskets were observed in poor repair on the prep unit by front counter and 2-door freezer #2. Refrigerator door gaskets shall be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 09/26/2026

The hand sinks by the front food preparation area were observed to be draining slowly and backing up into the sink basin and is in poor repair. Plumbing systems including drainage systems shall be maintained in good repair to prevent potential contamination from improper drainage. New Violation. Correct By: 09/02/2026

The ceiling in the back food preparation area is covered with tiles that are not smooth, durable, and easily cleanable. Establishment is to install ceiling tiles that are smooth, durable, easily cleanable, and non-absorbent. New Violation. Correct By: 09/16/2026

Protective shielding is not provided for the lights in the back food preparation area. Light bulbs must be shielded, coated, or otherwise shatter-resistant in areas where there is exposed food; clean equipment, utensils, and linens; or unwrapped single-service and single-use articles. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 07/16/2026

The hand-washing sink in the kitchen was blocked by kitchen utensils and equipment. A hand-washing sink shall be accessible at all times for employee use. Equipment and utensils were moved during the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/16/2026
Refrigerator door gaskets were observed in poor repair on the walk-in cooler. Refrigerator door gaskets shall be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 07/16/2026

The ceiling in the back food preparation area is covered with tiles that are not smooth, durable, and easily cleanable. Establishment is to install ceiling tiles that are smooth, durable, easily cleanable, and non-absorbent. New Violation. Correct By: 09/16/2026

Protective shielding is not provided for the lights in the back food preparation area. Light bulbs must be shielded, coated, or otherwise shatter-resistant in areas where there is exposed food; clean equipment, utensils, and linens; or unwrapped single-service and single-use articles. New Violation. Correct By: 07/16/2026
